<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Dismissal" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/dismissal">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Dismissal" name="Dismissal"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Dismissal">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_MPON" name="MPON" processRef="Process_MPON"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_MPOO" name="MPOO" processRef="Process_MPOO"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Dismissal" name="Dismissal" sourceRef="Task_SendDismissal" targetRef="StartEvent_MPOO" messageRef="Message_Dismissal"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MPON" name="MPON process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_MPON" name="Dismissal to be sent">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPON_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDismissal" name="Send dismissal to MPOO" messageRef="Message_Dismissal">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPON_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPON_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MPON" name="Dismissal sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPON_2</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPON_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_MPON" targetRef="Task_SendDismissal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPON_2" sourceRef="Task_SendDismissal" targetRef="EndEvent_MPON"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MPOO" name="MPOO process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_MPOO" name="Dismissal received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_MPOO" messageRef="Message_Dismissal"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewDismissal" name="Review dismissal">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Decision_Split" name="Decision on dismissal">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OpposeDismissal" name="Oppose dismissal of MPON">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmDismissal" name="Confirm dismissal of MPON">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Opposed" name="Dismissal opposed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_5</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Confirmed" name="Dismissal confirmed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_6</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_MPOO" targetRef="Task_ReviewDismissal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_2" sourceRef="Task_ReviewDismissal" targetRef="Gateway_Decision_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_3" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision_Split" targetRef="Task_OpposeDismissal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_4" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision_Split" targetRef="Task_ConfirmDismissal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_5" sourceRef="Task_OpposeDismissal" targetRef="EndEvent_Opposed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_6" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmDismissal" targetRef="EndEvent_Confirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description states that one participant sends a document or decision to another participant as a plain step that the receiver then acts on, and it gives no message content, no response to wait for, and no pool-to-pool exchange: Model the sending step as a plain task in the sender's lane, not as a send task. Use a send task only when the description makes the message emission itself the unit of work, for example by giving its content or requiring a message flow to a receiver in another pool.
rules.situation: the description states that one participant sends a document or decision to another participant as a plain step that the receiver then acts on, and it gives no message content, no response to wait for, and no pool-to-pool exchange

rules.instruction: When the description states a decision whose alternative branches later converge again before a shared activity or end event: Model the decision as an exclusive gateway split with labeled outgoing flows for each alternative. Join the alternative branches with a separate exclusive gateway merge placed immediately before the shared activity or end event. Do not route the alternative branches with direct sequence flows into one shared element, and do not drop the merge or the split.
rules.situation: the description gives a decision with two alternative outcomes (either one or the other) and states that both outcomes lead to the same following step or end state

rules.instruction: When the description states that a participant either performs one action or another alternative action, and each alternative is described as ending in a different outcome: Give each alternative branch its own end event that names its outcome. Do not join alternative branches with an exclusive gateway that leads to one shared end event unless the description says the alternatives converge to the same subsequent step.
rules.situation: the description states that a participant either performs one action or another alternative action, and each alternative is described as ending in a different outcome
